title: Malaysia declares emergency in Sarawak town as haze pollution level hits 521

article.title: Malaysia declares emergency in Sarawak town as haze pollution level hits 521
article.summary: Malaysia declared an emergency on Friday in a town in Sarawak state on Borneo Island after air pollution breached the country’s emergency-level threshold linked to fires in neighbouring Indonesia. The Air Pollutant Index in Serian, a small agricultural town of just under 90,000 near the border of Indonesia’s Kalimantan province, surged to 521 on Friday, according to Malaysia’s environment department.
